description: This file defines the main class 'Smarty' which is the core of the Smarty PHP template engine. It includes setup for directory paths, configuration, plugin management, security, caching, and rendering templates. The file also loads necessary internal plugin files and sets up constants related to the Smarty engine version and environment.

classes.name: Smarty
classes.description: Main class representing the Smarty template engine, managing configuration, directories, security, plugins, cache, and template rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Smarty object, sets up environment parameters, and normalizes charset.

methods.name: templateExists
methods.description: Checks whether a specified template resource exists.

methods.name: disableSecurity

methods.name: addTemplateDir

methods.name: getTemplateDir
